admission.justification: Filtering a user server or the only product definition would strand the agent; failing the legacy filter restores duplication.

applicability: Current and saved supplied MCP maps passed through the host bridge.
conditions: Remove only the ambient product entry when the bound task server is supplied or the saved legacy mode requires that filter.
Preserve every other supplied definition byte-for-byte in meaning.
A map without the task server keeps its sole product definition.
exclusions: This supplied-map filter does not establish suppression of harness-loaded ambient configuration.

evidence: the two places named in found_at; notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/260928-MIK-L113-repair-of-round-1-attempt-A2-37.md, section 2

statement: A supplied map of tool servers that names `agents-remember-task` is handed to the host without the entry `agents-remember` and with every other entry unchanged; a saved call recorded under the earlier mode loses the entry as then, and a map without the task server keeps it.
